title: Two Pontotoc shops confirm 7–11 p.m. hours on Thanksgiving night
excerpt: Anna Jade Boutique and City Mercantile posted their Thursday hours. Anna Jade also lists daytime hours for Wednesday, Friday and Saturday.

paragraphs.text: Anna Jade Boutique and City Mercantile will both open from 7 to 11 p.m. on Thanksgiving in Pontotoc. The two stores posted the same four-hour window for Thursday, Nov. 26, when local retailers take part in the Chamber’s Feast Then Fashion shopping night.

For shoppers running errands before the holiday, Anna Jade’s Wednesday hours are 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. The Main Street boutique will also open from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. on Friday, Nov. 27, and from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. on Saturday, Nov. 28.

City Mercantile’s announcement puts its Black Friday event on Thursday night. The store lists cider sampling and gift bags for the first 15 people in line. Other Pontotoc shops set their own hours for Feast Then Fashion, so the two confirmed openings are a guide to those stores only.
